player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} HighSociety khelār (2-jan khelār version) me.
Khelār gatividhi:  Das prestige card ekōr sange auction kōriyā.
Bidding:    Pratyek auction me, gōpōnē 1-11 taka card chāon ār ujagar kōriyā.
            • Beshi bid wale prestige card jite pārē ār se taka card fele dei.
            • Kām bid wale taka card rākhē.
            • Tie -> dui bid wale taka card wapas dei ār se prestige card abār auction kōriyā.
Scoring:    Das auction seshē, **bāki taka + prestige poinṭ** jōg kōriyā.
            Beshi *net-worth* wale jite pārē (thik tie -> draw).

**Kāj syntax**  →  ekṭā card bid kōriyā '[7]' bā '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ᱢᱤᱫ [X] ᱢᱟᱱᱮ ᱠᱟᱨᱰ ᱮᱢ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜ ᱢᱟ ᱾
invalid_move.card_not_held: ᱟᱢᱟᱜ ᱱᱤᱛᱚᱜ ᱚᱱᱟ ᱠᱟᱨᱰ ᱫᱚ ᱵᱟᱹᱱᱩᱜ-ᱟ᱾
